Major websites are blocking AI agents from completing shopping, banking and booking tasks, according to The Verge. Users of agents from Meta, xAI, OpenAI and Instinct report refusals across several major platforms. The episode exposes a growing tension between automated web access and site-level access controls. #AIAgents #WebSecurity #AISecurity
